verdict.line: You lose if you feed autos into Counter Strike's dodge-stun before level 6; you win if you poke with Q from range and hold Devour for his all-in.

brief.thesis: Jax's entire trade pattern hinges on E (Counter Strike), 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown, which dodges all basic attacks for its duration and then stuns and damages everyone around him when it ends — that stun is what turns a normal exchange into a kill. Tahm's Q (Tongue Lash) outranges that interaction by 600 units (900 vs Jax's 300 E range), so the lane is decided by whether you poke from distance or walk into auto range while his dodge window is live. At 49.7% over 187 games this is a genuine coinflip, not a losing lane — the deciding factor is who respects the other's cooldowns better.

theirWindow.when: Counter Strike and Leap Strike both ready
theirWindow.what: Do not auto-attack into him here — he'll dodge your hits with E then stun you when it ends, and Q (Leap Strike) lets him close the gap you just opened. Poke with Q (900 range, 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s cooldown) instead and back off.

yourWindow.what: OP.GG's own read holds: he's an easy target without E. Walk up and trade autos freely, land Q for the slow and the An Acquired Taste stack, and consider Devour if he's already at three stacks.

start.why: 51.9% win rate over 158 games and the higher pick rate (64.2%) over Doran's Helm — the flat damage reduction on the first attack from a champion blunts Jax's auto-reliant poke before level 6.

boots.why: 50.4% win rate over 137 games and the clear pick-rate favorite (59.1%) — directly reduces incoming basic attack damage, which is exactly how Jax deals damage via R (Relentless Assault) stacking.

core.why: Stacks bonus health from landing abilities, which directly scales Tahm's passive (extra damage based on total health) and his Thick Skin shield pool.
Follows Heartsteel in the highest win-rate path measured (77.3% over 22 games).
Completes the top core path (77.3% win rate, 17.9% pick) — adds sustained magic damage that scales with the health you're already stacking.

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on your first hit per fight, healing you and growing your max health — that health growth directly increases both your passive damage and your Thick Skin shield cap, so it compounds with the build rather than just sustaining lane.

summoners.why: The top measured page (51% win rate, 59.8% pick) — Ignite punishes Jax's all-in the moment Counter Strike goes down and secures the solo kill in a lane that's otherwise a dead coinflip, while Flash covers Devour engages and E-dodge punishes.

playing.title: Poke, don't auto
playing.detail: Use Q at its full 900 range to build An Acquired Taste stacks and heal without ever feeding Counter Strike a target — Jax's E only reaches 300 range, so standing outside it denies him the dodge entirely.

playing.title: Track Counter Strike's cooldown
playing.detail: It's 18/16/14/12/10s. Once he burns it baiting a stun or dodging your autos, that full window is yours to walk up and trade freely, exactly as OP.GG's own tip describes.

playing.title: Hold R for a stacked Jax
playing.detail: Devour has no cooldown of its own but needs three stacks of An Acquired Taste from Q and autos landing — build those stacks first, then Devour him out of his all-in instead of trying to out-trade Relentless Assault.

playing.title: Pop E's shield before he commits
playing.detail: Thick Skin passively stores a percent of damage taken while out of combat; activate it right as he leaps in with Q (Leap Strike) so his burst lands on a shield instead of your health bar.

playing.title: Respect R once it's online at 6
playing.detail: Relentless Assault gives him attack speed per hit with bonus damage every third swing — he wins extended auto trades the moment it's up, so disengage with Q's slow rather than standing and trading autos.

playing.title: Prioritize Heartsteel stacks 6-11
playing.detail: Your passive scales off total health, so farming camps and poke for Heartsteel stacks in this window is what flips the lane from even to favored by level 9.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and win rates are pulled directly from measured Tahm Kench vs Jax games on the current patch (16.20.1, 187 games); the cooldown numbers and the tactical reading of how those cooldowns interact are my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: As his (E) blocks basic attacks, use [Q] to create some distance before reengaging when (E) is on cooldown. He is an easy target without (E).
